北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感 -4℃，阳光正好，注意保暖和补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels -4℃. Sunny day, remember to stay warm and hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感 2℃，阴天湿冷。出门多穿点，别着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels 2℃, cloudy and damp. Dress warmly when you go out!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感 3℃，阴沉湿冷。记得添衣，照顾好自己。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels 3℃, cloudy and chilly. Remember to layer up and take care.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感 14℃，风力 4级有点凉。记得添件外套哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels 14℃, a bit cool with a Level 4 wind. Don't forget a jacket!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳体感 19℃，凉爽宜人。注意保暖，别着凉。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels 19℃, pleasantly cool. Stay warm and don't catch a cold.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州体感 -3℃，风大湿冷。裹紧大衣，别冻着！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou feels -3℃, windy and damp. Bundle up, don't get frozen!
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 -1℃，阴冷。多穿厚衣，喝杯热饮暖身吧。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels -1℃, cloudy and cold. Wear warm clothes, a hot drink would be nice!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都体感 5℃，阴天微凉。早晚温差大，注意添衣。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu feels 5℃, cloudy and a bit chilly. Big temp difference, dress in layers.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感 -2℃，阴沉湿冷。暖宝宝备好了吗？
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels -2℃, cloudy and damp. Got your hand warmers ready?

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感 0℃，阴天微凉。暖暖身子，注意别感冒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels 0℃, cloudy and cool. Keep warm and avoid catching a cold.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阵雨湿冷，体感 6℃。出门记得带伞哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has showers and feels 6℃, damp. Don't forget your umbrella!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -24℃，晴朗冻人！穿最厚的羽绒服吧。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels -24℃, clear but freezing! Wear your warmest down jacket.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 -20℃，晴冷。全副武装，注意防寒！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels -20℃, clear and cold. Bundle up, protect yourself from the chill!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明体感 13℃，阳光正好。享受这春日暖阳吧！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming feels 13℃, sunny and pleasant. Enjoy the spring sunshine!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门体感 12℃，阴天风大。注意防风，别着凉哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen feels 12℃, cloudy and windy. Protect from wind, don't catch a cold.
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感 -7℃，风力 5级刺骨。帽子手套都戴好！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels -7℃, a biting Level 5 wind. Wear your hat and gloves!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 -18℃，风力 5级冻人。全方位保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels -18℃, a freezing Level 5 wind. Stay warm all over!
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -18℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级
